newsitem.title: CHINA: China hopes to find oil in western Qaidam basin.
newsitem.headline: China hopes to find oil in western Qaidam basin.

text.p: China will try to expand exploration for oil and gas in the Qaidam basin in western Qinghai province, which produced 1.4 million tonnes of crude in 1996, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
In 1996, the basin also produced 120 million cubic metres of gas and an additional 40 million tonnes of oil reserves and five billion cubic metres of gas reserves were verified, it said.
The province plans to produce 1.5 million tonnes of crude oil and 200 million cubic metres of gas this year, it said.
The province will accelerate construction of the second phase of the Golmud Oil Refinery, with total investment of 230 million yuan, it said. The project is expected to be finished in September.
The region already had a verified 208 million tonnes of oil reserves and 59.3 billion cubic metres of gas reserves in the Qaidam basin's 22 oilfields, it said.
The province and Exxon Corp of the United States have spent $3.95 million on oil prospecting in the basin since 1995, it said.
